name: World English Bible (WEB)
normalization: Footnotes (<f>), cross references (<x>) and published verse numbers (<vp>) removed; every other tag dropped and its text kept; entities unescaped; whitespace collapsed to one space and trimmed. Canonical JSON hash uses UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true and compact separators.
notice: Used only to judge whether a spoken quotation covers a whole verse. Never displayed, dubbed or translated; the mirror file is not publisher-verified.
